cohort: The study included 2515 men and women aged between 18 and 35 years, living in Spain, with varying sexual attractions and places of birth.
finding: In Spain, 94.7% of men and 74.6% of women aged 18-34 reported voluntarily using pornography at some point, with consumption increasing with age and being associated with bisexual/homosexual attraction in women and a foreign place of birth in both sexes.
